title: •Leslomy Tacema
caption: •Leslomy Tacema (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. While on Tatooine, your docking bay transit to and from Tatooine is free. Power +2 at Cantina, Mos Eisley, or a docking bay. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Bo Shuda, Ellorrs Madak, or Yerka Mig.
lore: Female Duros. Expert pilot. Helps run the docking facilities in Mos Eisley. Friends with Ellorrs Madak. Approves all cargo manifests. Forgiving of minor transgressions.
copyright: TM & © 1998 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 1 / ABILITY 2, third box blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 3 (printed 2/2). Text opens with the yellow pilot icon + '3.' → {pilot:3} (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything she pilots'); ▼ where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Icon column: pilot, warrior (the printed card has pilot only — the slip adds warrior). Alien. The wiki's default 'Leslomy Tacema' page is the Glossary 2.0 errata version; printed face = 'Leslomy Tacema (Original)'. The 745 px JP-L-leslomytacema.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face) — downloaded to src/vs8/12-JP-L-leslomytacema.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore matches both scans. Copyright 1998 (Jabba's Palace). Modern: V3-L-leslomytacema.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 3 remake); VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
